content.text: The covering-array test returned exactly the independently predicted 4,845 eligible clauses in one class and produced all three query statuses correctly. I’m finishing with exact-rational and zero-context-source checks, then removing development artifacts from the submission.

arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/devtests/test_directed.py <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,copy

def run(r):
 p=subprocess.run(['/app/submission/run.sh'],input=json.dumps(r).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=10);assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr;return json.loads(p.stdout)
# (3 * mean) == 2 is true exactly when the three values sum to two.
mean={'aggregate':'mean','field':'x','from':0,'to':2}
a={'cmp':'eq','left':{'scale':3,'term':mean},'right':{'const':2,'type':'SIZE'}}
def tr(i,vals,source='s'):return {'id':i,'source':source,'rows':[{'t':j,'values':[v]} for j,v in enumerate(vals)]}
r={'version':1,'schema':[{'name':'x','type':'SIZE','min':0,'max':10}],'window':3,'atoms':[a],'policy':{'max_width':4,'min_support':1,'min_witness':1},'train':[tr('train',[0,1,1])],'probes':[tr('probe',[0,0,0])],'queries':[tr('qtrue',[0,0,2]),tr('qfalse',[0,0,1]),tr('qorder',[2,1,0])]}
o=run(r);print('rational',o)
assert o['classes'][0]['members']==1
assert [(q['trace'],q['status']) for q in o['queries']]==[('qtrue','consistent'),('qfalse','violating'),('qorder','violating')]
# qorder sorts to [0,1,2], whose sum is three, hence the clause is false.
# A declared training source with no contexts prevents every positive-support literal.
r=copy.deepcopy(r);r['train'].append({'id':'short','source':'empty','rows':[]});o=run(r);assert o['classes']==[] and all(q['status']=='consistent' for q in o['queries']);print('zero-context source passed')
# Five probes require two hexadecimal digits, including leading zeroes.
r=copy.deepcopy(r);r['train']=r['train'][:1];r['probes']=[tr('p'+str(i),[0,0,0]) for i in range(5)]
for i,p in enumerate(r['probes']):p['id']='p'+str(i)
o=run(r);assert len(o['classes'][0]['signature'])==2 and o['classes'][0]['signature']=='00';print('signature padding passed')
# ID constants need not belong to a field's declared domain.
r={'version':1,'schema':[{'name':'id','type':'ID','values':['a']}],'window':1,'atoms':[{'cmp':'eq','left':{'field':'id','at':0},'right':{'const':'not_in_domain','type':'ID'}}],'policy':{'max_width':1,'min_support':1,'min_witness':1},'train':[],'probes':[],'queries':[]}
assert run(r)=={'version':1,'classes':[],'queries':[]};print('ID constant domain independence passed')
PY
